21	Section EulerianBasic.
22	
23	Lemma eulerian_row_sum n : \sum_(k < n.+1) eulerian n k = #|{perm 'I_n.+1}|.
24	Proof.
25	rewrite /eulerian -sum1_card.
26	rewrite (partition_big (fun s : {perm 'I_n.+1} => inord (des s) : 'I_n.+1) xpredT) //=.
27	apply: eq_bigr => k _; rewrite -sum1_card; apply: eq_bigl => s; rewrite inE.
28	by rewrite -val_eqE /= inordK // ltnS des_le.
29	Qed.
30	
31	Lemma eulerian_row_sum_fact n : \sum_(k < n.+1) eulerian n k = n.+1`!.
32	Proof. by rewrite eulerian_row_sum card_Sn. Qed.
33	
34	Lemma eulerian_out_of_range n k : n < k -> eulerian n k = 0.
35	Proof.
36	move=> nk; apply/eqP; rewrite cards_eq0; apply/eqP/setP => s.
37	rewrite !inE; apply/negbTE; rewrite neq_ltn.
38	by rewrite (leq_ltn_trans (des_le s) nk).
39	Qed.
40	
41	Lemma des0_id n (s : {perm 'I_n.+1}) : des s = 0 -> s = 1%g.
42	Proof.
43	move=> Hds.
44	have Hds0 : descent_set s = set0.
45	  by apply/eqP; rewrite -cards_eq0; apply/eqP.
46	have Hmono : forall i : 'I_n,
47	    (val (s (widen_ord (leqnSn n) i)) < val (s (lift ord0 i)))%N.
48	  move=> i.
49	  have Hneq : widen_ord (leqnSn n) i != lift ord0 i.
50	    by apply/eqP => /(congr1 val) /=; rewrite /bump /= add1n => /n_Sn.
51	  have : i \notin descent_set s by rewrite Hds0 inE.
52	  rewrite mem_descent_set /is_descent -leqNgt ltn_neqAle => -> /=.
53	  by rewrite andbT; apply/eqP => /val_inj/perm_inj/eqP; apply/negP.
54	have Hle : forall i : 'I_n.+1, (val i <= val (s i))%N.
55	  case=> m; elim: m => [|m IHm] Hm; first exact: leq0n.
56	  have Hm1 : m < n.+1 by apply: ltnW.
57	  have Hmn : m < n by [].
58	  have := Hmono (Ordinal Hmn).
59	  have -> : widen_ord (leqnSn n) (Ordinal Hmn) = Ordinal Hm1.
60	    exact: val_inj.
61	  have -> : lift ord0 (Ordinal Hmn) = Ordinal Hm.
62	    by apply: val_inj; rewrite /= /bump /= add1n.
63	  by move/(leq_ltn_trans (IHm Hm1)).
64	have Hsum : \sum_(i : 'I_n.+1) (val (s i) - val i)%N = 0.
65	  rewrite sumnB //.
66	  have -> : \sum_(i : 'I_n.+1) val (s i)
67	          = \sum_(i : 'I_n.+1) val i.
68	    by rewrite [RHS](reindex_inj (@perm_inj _ s)).
69	  by rewrite subnn.
70	apply/permP => i; rewrite perm1; apply/val_inj.
71	move/eqP: Hsum; rewrite (bigD1 i) //= addn_eq0 subn_eq0 => /andP[/eqP Hi _].
72	by apply/eqP; rewrite eqn_leq Hle /= -subn_eq0 Hi.
73	Qed.
74	
75	Lemma eulerian_n_0 n : eulerian n 0 = 1.
76	Proof.
77	rewrite /eulerian -(cards1 (1%g : {perm 'I_n.+1})); apply: eq_card => s.
78	rewrite !inE; apply/eqP/eqP => [/des0_id //|->]; exact: des_id.
79	Qed.

81	End EulerianBasic.

84	(* Symmetry: eulerian n k = eulerian n (n - k)                               *)

87	Lemma rev_perm_inj n : injective (@rev_perm n).
88	Proof. by move=> s1 s2; rewrite /rev_perm; exact: mulgI. Qed.
89	
90	Lemma rev_perm_involutive n : involutive (@rev_perm n).
91	Proof.
92	move=> s; apply/permP => j.
93	by rewrite !rev_permE rev_ordK.
94	Qed.
95	
96	Lemma eulerian_symm n k : k <= n -> eulerian n k = eulerian n (n - k).
97	Proof.
98	move=> kn; rewrite /eulerian.
99	rewrite -(card_imset _ (@rev_perm_inj n)).
100	congr #|pred_of_set _|; apply/setP => s; rewrite !inE.
101	apply/imsetP/idP.
102	+ by case=> t; rewrite inE => /eqP <- ->; rewrite des_rev_perm.
103	+ move=> /eqP Hs; exists (rev_perm s); last by rewrite rev_perm_involutive.
104	  by rewrite inE des_rev_perm Hs subKn.
105	Qed.
106	
107	Lemma eulerian_n_n n : eulerian n n = 1.
108	Proof. by rewrite (eulerian_symm (leqnn n)) subnn eulerian_n_0. Qed.

111	(* Recurrence:                                                               *)
112	(*   eulerian n.+1 k.+1 = k.+2 * eulerian n k.+1 + (n.+1 - k) * eulerian n k *)
113	(* (The k = 0 case is eulerian_n_0: eulerian n.+1 0 = 1.)                    *)
114	(*                                                                           *)
115	(* We prove this via the "insert-max-value" bijection                        *)
116	(*   {perm 'I_n.+2} ≅ {perm 'I_n.+1} × 'I_n.+2                               *)
117	(*   σ ↦ (τ, p)                                                              *)
118	(* where p = σ^{-1}(ord_max) is the position of the max value and τ is       *)
119	(* obtained by deleting that max from σ's one-line notation.                 *)
120	(* ========================================================================= *)

123	(* Helpers on widen_ord (leqnSn n.+1) : 'I_n.+1 -> 'I_n.+2                   *)
124	(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
125	
126	Lemma widenSn_inj n : injective (widen_ord (leqnSn n.+1)).
127	Proof. by move=> i1 i2 H; apply/val_inj; exact: (congr1 val H). Qed.
128	
129	Lemma widenSn_neq_ord_max n (j : 'I_n.+1) :
130	  widen_ord (leqnSn n.+1) j != (ord_max : 'I_n.+2).
131	Proof.
132	by apply/eqP => H; move: (congr1 val H) (ltn_ord j) => /= ->; rewrite ltnn.
133	Qed.

136	(* insert_max_perm: inserting max value at a given position                  *)
137	(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
138	
139	Section InsertMax.
140	Variables (n : nat) (t : {perm 'I_n.+1}) (p : 'I_n.+2).
141	
142	Definition insert_max_fun (i : 'I_n.+2) : 'I_n.+2 :=
143	  match unlift p i with
144	  | Some j => widen_ord (leqnSn _) (t j)
145	  | None => ord_max
146	  end.
147	
148	Lemma insert_max_fun_p : insert_max_fun p = ord_max.
149	Proof. by rewrite /insert_max_fun unlift_none. Qed.
150	
151	Lemma insert_max_fun_lift (j : 'I_n.+1) :
152	  insert_max_fun (lift p j) = widen_ord (leqnSn _) (t j).
153	Proof. by rewrite /insert_max_fun liftK. Qed.
154	
155	Lemma insert_max_fun_inj : injective insert_max_fun.
156	Proof.
157	move=> i1 i2; rewrite /insert_max_fun.
158	case: (unliftP p i1) => [j1 ->|->]; case: (unliftP p i2) => [j2 ->|->].
159	- by move/widenSn_inj/perm_inj ->.
160	- by move/eqP; rewrite (negbTE (widenSn_neq_ord_max _)).
161	- by move/eqP; rewrite eq_sym (negbTE (widenSn_neq_ord_max _)).
162	- by [].
163	Qed.
164	
165	Definition insert_max_perm : {perm 'I_n.+2} := perm insert_max_fun_inj.
166	
167	Lemma insert_max_permE i : insert_max_perm i = insert_max_fun i.
168	Proof. by rewrite permE. Qed.
169	
170	Lemma insert_max_perm_at_p : insert_max_perm p = ord_max.
171	Proof. by rewrite insert_max_permE insert_max_fun_p. Qed.
172	
173	Lemma insert_max_perm_lift (j : 'I_n.+1) :
174	  insert_max_perm (lift p j) = widen_ord (leqnSn _) (t j).
175	Proof. by rewrite insert_max_permE insert_max_fun_lift. Qed.
176	
177	End InsertMax.

183	Section ExtractMax.
184	Variables (n : nat) (s : {perm 'I_n.+2}) (p : 'I_n.+2).
185	Hypothesis (sp : s p = ord_max).
186	
187	Fact extract_max_ne (j : 'I_n.+1) : s (lift p j) != (ord_max : 'I_n.+2).
188	Proof.
189	rewrite -sp; apply/eqP => /perm_inj /eqP.
190	by rewrite eq_sym (negbTE (neq_lift _ _)).
191	Qed.
192	
193	Definition extract_max_fun (j : 'I_n.+1) : 'I_n.+1 :=
194	  odflt j (unlift ord_max (s (lift p j))).
195	
196	Lemma extract_max_funE (j : 'I_n.+1) :
197	  widen_ord (leqnSn n.+1) (extract_max_fun j) = s (lift p j).
198	Proof.
199	rewrite /extract_max_fun.
200	case: (unliftP ord_max (s (lift p j))) => [k ->|H] /=.
201	- by apply: val_inj; rewrite /= /bump /= leqNgt ltn_ord.
202	- by move: (extract_max_ne j); rewrite H eqxx.
203	Qed.
204	
205	Lemma extract_max_fun_inj : injective extract_max_fun.
206	Proof.
207	move=> j1 j2 /(congr1 (widen_ord (leqnSn n.+1))).
208	rewrite !extract_max_funE => /perm_inj /lift_inj //.
209	Qed.
210	
211	Definition extract_max_perm : {perm 'I_n.+1} := perm extract_max_fun_inj.
212	
213	Lemma extract_max_permE j : extract_max_perm j = extract_max_fun j.
214	Proof. by rewrite permE. Qed.
215	
216	Lemma extract_max_widen (j : 'I_n.+1) :
217	  widen_ord (leqnSn n.+1) (extract_max_perm j) = s (lift p j).
218	Proof. by rewrite extract_max_permE extract_max_funE. Qed.
219	
220	End ExtractMax.

223	(* Bijection: insert_max_perm and extract_max_perm are inverses             *)
224	(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
225	
226	Section InsertExtractBij.
227	Variable n : nat.
228	
229	Lemma extract_insert_max (t : {perm 'I_n.+1}) (p : 'I_n.+2) :
230	  extract_max_perm (insert_max_perm_at_p t p) = t.
231	Proof.
232	apply/permP => j; apply: (@widenSn_inj n).
233	by rewrite (extract_max_widen (insert_max_perm_at_p _ _)) insert_max_perm_lift.
234	Qed.
235	
236	Lemma insert_extract_max (s : {perm 'I_n.+2}) (p : 'I_n.+2)
237	    (sp : s p = ord_max) :
238	  insert_max_perm (extract_max_perm sp) p = s.
239	Proof.
240	apply/permP => i; rewrite insert_max_permE /insert_max_fun.
241	case: (unliftP p i) => [j ->|->]; last exact/esym.
242	by rewrite -extract_max_widen.
243	Qed.
244	
245	End InsertExtractBij.

251	Section DesInsertMax.
252	Variables (n : nat) (t : {perm 'I_n.+1}).
253	
254	Lemma des_insert_max_ord0 :
255	  des (insert_max_perm t ord0) = (des t).+1.
256	Proof.
257	rewrite /des /descent_set.
258	suff -> : [set i : 'I_n.+1 | is_descent (insert_max_perm t ord0) i]
259	        = (ord0 : 'I_n.+1) |: [set lift ord0 j | j in [set i | is_descent t i]].
260	  rewrite cardsU1 card_imset; last exact: lift_inj.
261	  have -> : ord0 \notin [set lift ord0 j | j in [set i | is_descent t i]].
262	    apply/imsetP => -[x _ Hx].
263	    by have := neq_lift ord0 x; rewrite -Hx eqxx.
264	  by rewrite add1n.
265	apply/setP => i; rewrite !inE.
266	case: (unliftP ord0 i) => [j ->|->].
267	- rewrite eq_sym (negbTE (neq_lift _ _)) /=.
268	  have E1 : widen_ord (leqnSn n.+1) (lift ord0 j)
269	          = lift ord0 (widen_ord (leqnSn n) j) :> 'I_n.+2.
270	    by apply/val_inj; rewrite /= /bump leq0n /= add1n.
271	  rewrite /is_descent E1 !insert_max_perm_lift.
272	  apply/idP/imsetP.
273	  + by move=> H; exists j; first by rewrite inE /is_descent.
274	  + by case=> j' /[!inE] Hj' /lift_inj ->; rewrite /is_descent.
275	- rewrite eqxx orTb /is_descent.
276	  have -> : widen_ord (leqnSn n.+1) (ord0 : 'I_n.+1) = ord0 :> 'I_n.+2.
277	    by apply/val_inj.
278	  by rewrite insert_max_perm_at_p insert_max_perm_lift /=; apply: ltn_ord.
279	Qed.
280	
281	Lemma des_insert_max_ord_max :
282	  des (insert_max_perm t (ord_max : 'I_n.+2)) = des t.
283	Proof.
284	rewrite /des /descent_set.
285	suff -> : [set i : 'I_n.+1 | is_descent (insert_max_perm t ord_max) i]
286	        = [set (lift ord_max j : 'I_n.+1) | j in [set i : 'I_n | is_descent t i]].
287	  by rewrite card_imset //; exact: lift_inj.
288	apply/setP => i; rewrite !inE.
289	case: (unliftP ord_max i) => [j ->|->].
290	- have E1 : widen_ord (leqnSn n.+1) (lift ord_max j)
291	          = lift ord_max (widen_ord (leqnSn n) j) :> 'I_n.+2.
292	    apply/val_inj; rewrite /= /bump /=.
293	    rewrite leqNgt (ltn_ord j) /=.
294	    by rewrite leqNgt (leq_trans (ltn_ord j) (leqnSn n)).
295	  have E2 : lift ord0 (lift ord_max j : 'I_n.+1)
296	          = lift ord_max (lift ord0 j) :> 'I_n.+2.
297	    apply/val_inj => /=.
298	    rewrite /bump /=.
299	    have H2 : (n <= j) = false by apply/negbTE; rewrite -ltnNge; apply: ltn_ord.
300	    have H3 : (n.+1 <= j.+1) = false by apply/negbTE; rewrite -ltnNge; apply: ltn_ord.
301	    by rewrite H2 H3.
302	  rewrite /is_descent E1 E2 !insert_max_perm_lift.
303	  apply/idP/imsetP.
304	  + by move=> H; exists j; first by rewrite inE /is_descent.
305	  + by case=> j' /[!inE] Hj' /lift_inj ->; rewrite /is_descent.
306	- rewrite /is_descent.
307	  have E1 : widen_ord (leqnSn n.+1) (ord_max : 'I_n.+1)
308	          = lift ord_max (ord_max : 'I_n.+1) :> 'I_n.+2.
309	    by apply/val_inj; rewrite /= /bump /= leqNgt ltnSn.
310	  have -> : lift ord0 (ord_max : 'I_n.+1) = ord_max :> 'I_n.+2.
311	    by apply/val_inj.
312	  rewrite E1 insert_max_perm_lift insert_max_perm_at_p.
313	  apply/idP/imsetP.
314	  + by move=> H; move: (ltn_ord (t (ord_max : 'I_n.+1)));
315	       rewrite ltnNge /= in H; case/negP: H; apply: ltnW.
316	  + case=> j _ /eqP; rewrite -val_eqE /= /bump /= leqNgt ltn_ord /= => /eqP eqn.
317	    rewrite add0n in eqn.
318	    by move: (ltn_ord j); rewrite -eqn ltnn.
319	Qed.
320	
321	Lemma des_insert_max_interior (j : 'I_n) :
322	  des (insert_max_perm t (lift ord0 (widen_ord (leqnSn n) j))) =
323	    des t + ~~ is_descent t j.
324	Proof.
325	set h := widen_ord (leqnSn n) j.
326	set p := lift ord0 h.
327	set sigma := insert_max_perm t p.
328	rewrite /des /descent_set.
329	suff -> : [set i | is_descent sigma i]
330	        = [set lift h x | x in [set y | is_descent t y] :|: [set j]].
331	  rewrite card_imset; last exact: lift_inj.
332	  rewrite setUC cardsU1 inE /=.
333	  by case: (is_descent t j); rewrite addnC.
334	apply/setP => i; rewrite !inE.
335	case: (unliftP h i) => [x ->|->].
336	- (* Goal: is_descent σ (lift h x) = x ∈ descent_set t ∪ {j} (up to lift h) *)
337	  have sigma_lift0 : forall x : 'I_n,
338	    sigma (lift ord0 (lift h x)) = widen_ord (leqnSn n.+1) (t (lift ord0 x)).
339	    move=> y.
340	    have E : lift ord0 (lift h y) = lift p (lift ord0 y) :> 'I_n.+2.
341	      by apply/val_inj => /=; rewrite /p /=; rewrite /bump /= addnCA.
342	    by rewrite /sigma E insert_max_perm_lift.
343	  have -> : (lift h x \in [set lift h x0 | x0 in [set y | is_descent t y] :|: [set j]])
344	          = (is_descent t x) || (x == j).
345	    apply/imsetP/idP => [[y]|].
346	    + by rewrite !inE => /orP[Hy|/eqP ->] /lift_inj ->;
347	         [rewrite Hy|rewrite eqxx orbT].
348	    + case/orP => [H|/eqP ->].
349	      - by exists x; rewrite // !inE H.
350	      - by exists j; rewrite // !inE eqxx orbT.
351	  rewrite /is_descent sigma_lift0 /=.
352	  case: (eqVneq x j) => [->|xnj].
353	  + have -> : sigma (widen_ord (leqnSn n.+1) (lift h j)) = ord_max.
354	      have E : widen_ord (leqnSn n.+1) (lift h j) = p :> 'I_n.+2.
355	        by apply/val_inj; rewrite /= /p /= /bump /= leqnn.
356	      by rewrite /sigma E insert_max_perm_at_p.
357	    by rewrite orbT; apply: ltn_ord.
358	  + rewrite orbF.
359	    have E : widen_ord (leqnSn n.+1) (lift h x) = lift p (widen_ord (leqnSn n) x) :> 'I_n.+2.
360	      apply/val_inj; rewrite /= /p /= /bump /=.
361	      case: (ltngtP x j) => [Hxj|Hxj|Hxj].
362	      - by [].
363	      - by [].
364	      - by rewrite -val_eqE /= Hxj eqxx in xnj.
365	    by rewrite /sigma E insert_max_perm_lift.
366	- (* Goal: is_descent σ h = h ∈ image (false) *)
367	  have Rfalse : (h \in [set lift h x | x in [set y | is_descent t y] :|: [set j]]) = false.
368	    by apply/negbTE/imsetP => -[y _ Hy]; have := neq_lift h y; rewrite -Hy eqxx.
369	  rewrite Rfalse /is_descent.
370	  have E1 : widen_ord (leqnSn n.+1) h = lift p h :> 'I_n.+2.
371	    apply/val_inj; rewrite /= /p /= /bump /=.
372	    by rewrite add1n ltnn.
373	  have E2 : lift ord0 h = p :> 'I_n.+2 by [].
374	  rewrite E1 E2 insert_max_perm_lift insert_max_perm_at_p.
375	  apply/negbTE; rewrite -leqNgt.
376	  by apply: ltnW; rewrite /=; exact: ltn_ord.
377	Qed.
378	
379	End DesInsertMax.

382	(* Bijection on fibers: {σ : σ^{-1} ord_max = p} ≃ {perm 'I_n.+1}           *)
383	(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
384	
385	Lemma insert_max_perm_fiber n (p : 'I_n.+2) (t : {perm 'I_n.+1}) :
386	  ((insert_max_perm t p)^-1)%g ord_max = p.
387	Proof.
388	apply: (@perm_inj _ (insert_max_perm t p)).
389	by rewrite permKV insert_max_perm_at_p.
390	Qed.
391	
392	Lemma insert_max_perm_pair_inj n :
393	  injective (fun tp : {perm 'I_n.+1} * 'I_n.+2 => insert_max_perm tp.1 tp.2).
394	Proof.
395	move=> [t1 p1] [t2 p2] /= E.
396	have Ep : p1 = p2.
397	  by rewrite -(insert_max_perm_fiber p1 t1) -(insert_max_perm_fiber p2 t2) E.
398	move: E; rewrite Ep => E.
399	congr (_, _); apply/permP => i; apply: (@widenSn_inj n).
400	have := congr1 (fun s : {perm 'I_n.+2} => s (lift p2 i)) E.
401	by rewrite !insert_max_perm_lift.
402	Qed.
403	
404	Lemma insert_max_perm_pair_surj n (s : {perm 'I_n.+2}) :
405	  exists tp : {perm 'I_n.+1} * 'I_n.+2, s = insert_max_perm tp.1 tp.2.
406	Proof.
407	pose p : 'I_n.+2 := (s^-1)%g ord_max.
408	have sp : s p = ord_max by rewrite /p permKV.
409	exists (extract_max_perm sp, p) => /=.
410	by rewrite (insert_extract_max sp).
411	Qed.

416	
417	Lemma sum_descent n (t : {perm 'I_n.+1}) :
418	  \sum_(j : 'I_n) is_descent t j = des t.
419	Proof.
420	rewrite /des /descent_set -sum1dep_card [RHS]big_mkcond /=.
421	by apply: eq_bigr => j _; case: (is_descent t j).
422	Qed.
423	
424	Lemma sum_ascent n (t : {perm 'I_n.+1}) :
425	  \sum_(j : 'I_n) ~~ is_descent t j = n - des t.
426	Proof.
427	apply/eqP; rewrite -(eqn_add2l (des t)) subnKC ?des_le //.
428	rewrite -sum_descent -big_split /=.
429	rewrite (eq_bigr (fun _ => 1)); last by move=> j _; case: (is_descent t j).
430	by rewrite sum_nat_const card_ord muln1.
431	Qed.

433	(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
434	(* Main recurrence                                                           *)
435	(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
436	
437	Lemma extract_insert_maxPI n (t : {perm 'I_n.+1}) (p : 'I_n.+2)
438	  (sp : insert_max_perm t p p = ord_max) :
439	  extract_max_perm sp = t.
440	Proof.
441	apply/permP => j; apply: (@widenSn_inj n).
442	by rewrite extract_max_widen insert_max_perm_lift.
443	Qed.
444	
445	Lemma insert_max_perm_bij n :
446	  bijective (fun tp : {perm 'I_n.+1} * 'I_n.+2 => insert_max_perm tp.1 tp.2).
447	Proof.
448	pose g (s : {perm 'I_n.+2}) : {perm 'I_n.+1} * 'I_n.+2 :=
449	  (extract_max_perm (permKV s ord_max), (s^-1)%g ord_max).
450	exists g.
451	- move=> [t p] /=; rewrite /g /=.
452	  (* First extract p *)
453	  congr pair; last exact: insert_max_perm_fiber.
454	  apply/permP => j; apply: (@widenSn_inj n).
455	  rewrite extract_max_widen.
456	  have E : lift ((insert_max_perm t p)^-1%g ord_max) j = lift p j :> 'I_n.+2.
457	    by apply/val_inj; rewrite /= insert_max_perm_fiber.
458	  by rewrite E insert_max_perm_lift.
459	- move=> s /=; rewrite /g; exact: insert_extract_max.
460	Qed.
461	
462	(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
463	(* Main recurrence                                                            *)
464	(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
465	
466	Lemma eulerian_rec n k :
467	  eulerian n.+1 k.+1 = k.+2 * eulerian n k.+1 + (n.+1 - k) * eulerian n k.
468	Proof.
469	rewrite /eulerian -sum1dep_card.
470	rewrite (reindex _ (onW_bij _ (insert_max_perm_bij n))) /=.
471	rewrite -(pair_big_dep xpredT
472	            (fun t p => des (insert_max_perm t p) == k.+1)
473	            (fun _ _ => 1)) /=.
474	under eq_bigr => t _ do rewrite big_mkcond /=.
475	under eq_bigr => t _ do rewrite big_ord_recl big_ord_recr /=.
476	have lom : lift ord0 (ord_max : 'I_n.+1) = (ord_max : 'I_n.+2) by apply/val_inj.
477	under eq_bigr => t _ do rewrite lom.
478	under eq_bigr => t _ do rewrite des_insert_max_ord0 des_insert_max_ord_max.
479	under eq_bigr => t _ do under eq_bigr => i _ do rewrite des_insert_max_interior.
480	under eq_bigr => t _.
481	  rewrite (bigID (fun i : 'I_n => is_descent t i)) /=.
482	  under eq_bigr => i Hi do rewrite Hi addn0.
483	  under [X in _ + X + _]eq_bigr => i Hi do rewrite (negbTE Hi) addn1.
484	  over.
485	under eq_bigr => t _ do rewrite !eqSS.
486	under eq_bigr => t _ do rewrite sum_nat_cond_const sum_nat_cond_const.
487	under eq_bigr => t _ do rewrite -/(descent_set t) -/(des t).
488	have asc_card (u : {perm 'I_n.+1}) : #|[set x | ~~ is_descent u x]| = n - des u.
489	  have -> : [set x | ~~ is_descent u x] = ~: [set x | is_descent u x].
490	    by apply/setP => i; rewrite !inE.
491	  by rewrite cardsCs setCK card_ord.
492	under eq_bigr => t _ do rewrite asc_card.
493	rewrite -!sum1dep_card !big_distrr /=.
494	rewrite [X in _ = _ + X]big_mkcond /= [X in _ = X + _]big_mkcond /= -big_split /=.
495	apply: eq_bigr => t _; rewrite !muln1.
496	case E1: (des t == k); case E2: (des t == k.+1); rewrite /= ?addn0 ?add0n ?mul0n ?muln0.
497	- move/eqP: E1 E2 => ->; move/eqP => Habs.
498	  by exfalso; move: (ltnSn k); rewrite {1}Habs ltnn.
499	- move/eqP: E1 => <-.
500	  by rewrite add0n muln1 add1n subSn //; apply: des_le.
501	- by move/eqP: E2 => ->; rewrite muln1 addn0 addn1.
502	- by [].
503	Qed.

505	(* ========================================================================= *)
506	(* Worpitzky's identity                                                       *)
507	(*   x^(n+1) = \sum_(k < n+1) eulerian n k * C(x+k, n+1)                      *)
508	(* ========================================================================= *)
509	
510	(* Key algebraic identity (valid for k <= n): *)
511	(*   x * C(x+k, n+1) = (k+1) * C(x+k, n+2) + (n+1-k) * C(x+k+1, n+2)         *)
512	Lemma worpitzky_binom_id x k n : k <= n ->
513	  x * 'C(x + k, n.+1) =
514	    k.+1 * 'C(x + k, n.+2) + (n.+1 - k) * 'C(x + k.+1, n.+2).
515	Proof.
516	move=> kle.
517	rewrite addnS binS mulnDr addnA -mulnDl.
518	have -> : k.+1 + (n.+1 - k) = n.+2 by rewrite addSn subnKC// ltnW.
519	rewrite mul_bin_left -mulnDl.
520	case: (leqP n.+1 (x + k)) => h.
521	- symmetry; rewrite addnBA; first by rewrite subnK // addnK.
522	  exact: ltnW.
523	- by rewrite !bin_small ?muln0 //; exact: (leq_trans h (leqnSn _)).
524	Qed.

526	Lemma worpitzky n x :
527	  x ^ n.+1 = \sum_(k < n.+1) eulerian n k * 'C(x + k, n.+1).
528	Proof.
529	elim: n x => [|n IH] x.
530	  by rewrite big_ord1 eulerian_n_0 mul1n bin1 addn0 expn1.
531	rewrite expnS IH big_distrr /=.
532	under eq_bigr => k _.
533	  rewrite mulnA (mulnC x) -mulnA.
534	  rewrite (worpitzky_binom_id _ _ (n := n)); last by rewrite -ltnS.
535	  rewrite mulnDr.
536	  over.
537	rewrite big_split /=.
538	rewrite big_ord_recl eulerian_n_0 mul1n addn0.
539	rewrite [RHS]big_ord_recl eulerian_n_0 mul1n addn0.
540	under [X in _ = _ + X]eq_bigr => i _ do rewrite eulerian_rec mulnDl.
541	rewrite big_split /=.
542	rewrite mul1n -addnA.
543	congr (_ + _).
544	congr (_ + _); last first.
545	- by apply: eq_bigr => i _; rewrite mulnCA /bump /= add1n mulnA.
546	rewrite [RHS]big_ord_recr /= eulerian_out_of_range ?ltnSn // muln0 mul0n addn0.
547	apply: eq_bigr => i _.
548	by rewrite /bump /= !add1n mulnCA mulnA.
549	Qed.
550	
551	(* ========================================================================= *)
552	(* Closed form (Eulerian explicit formula):                                   *)
553	(*   eulerian n k = \sum_(j <= k) (-1)^j C(n+2, j) (k+1-j)^(n+1)  [in int]    *)
554	(* ========================================================================= *)
555	
556	Import GRing.Theory.
557	Local Open Scope ring_scope.
558	
559	(* Alternating binomial convolution identity.                                *)
560	(* \sum_j (-1)^j C(n+2, j) C(t-j, n+1) = [t == n+1]                          *)
561	
562	(* Signed Pascal extension: works uniformly even when subtraction saturates. *)
563	Lemma binS' t n : 'C(t, n.+2) = 'C(t.-1, n.+2) + 'C(t.-1, n.+1).
564	Proof. by case: t => [|t]//=; rewrite binS. Qed.
565	
566	(* Key recurrence for the alternating sum: g(N+1, u) = g(N, u.-1).           *)
567	(* Proved via Pascal applied to both binomial factors plus reindex.          *)
568	Lemma aux_id_step (N u : nat) :
569	  \sum_(j < N.+4) (-1 : int) ^ j *+ 'C(N.+3, j) *+ 'C(u - j, N.+2) =
570	  \sum_(j < N.+3) (-1 : int) ^ j *+ 'C(N.+2, j) *+ 'C(u.-1 - j, N.+1).
571	Proof.
572	rewrite big_ord_recl [(-1) ^ ord0]expr0 bin0 mulr1n subn0.
573	under eq_bigr => i _ do rewrite binS mulrnDr mulrnDl.
574	rewrite big_split /=.
575	have beta_eq :
576	  \sum_(i < N.+3) ((-1 : int) ^ i.+1 *+ 'C(N.+2, i) *+ 'C(u - i.+1, N.+2)) =
577	  - \sum_(i < N.+3) ((-1 : int) ^ i *+ 'C(N.+2, i) *+ 'C(u.-1 - i, N.+2)).
578	  rewrite -sumrN; apply: eq_bigr => i _.
579	  by case: u => [|u']//=; rewrite exprSz mulN1r !mulNrn.
580	have alpha_eq :
581	  ('C(u, N.+2)%:R : int) +
582	  \sum_(i < N.+3) ((-1 : int) ^ i.+1 *+ 'C(N.+2, i.+1) *+ 'C(u - i.+1, N.+2)) =
583	  \sum_(j < N.+4) ((-1 : int) ^ j *+ 'C(N.+2, j) *+ 'C(u - j, N.+2)).
584	  rewrite [RHS]big_ord_recl [(-1) ^ ord0]expr0 bin0 mulr1n subn0.
585	  by congr (_ + _); apply: eq_bigr => i _.
586	rewrite addrA alpha_eq [\sum_(j < N.+4) _]big_ord_recr /= bin_small // mul0rn addr0 beta_eq.
587	rewrite -[_ + - _]/(_ - _) -sumrB; apply: eq_bigr => i _.
588	have aux v : ((v - i).-1 = v.-1 - i)%N by case: v => [|v']//=; rewrite -subnS.
589	by rewrite (binS' (u - i) N) (aux u) mulrnDr addrAC subrr add0r.
590	Qed.
591	
592	Lemma aux_id (n t : nat) :
593	  \sum_(j < n.+3) (-1) ^ j *+ 'C(n.+2, j) *+ 'C(t - j, n.+1) =
594	  (t == n.+1)%:Z.
595	Proof.
596	elim: n t => [|n IH] t; last by rewrite aux_id_step IH; case: t.
597	under eq_bigr => j _ do rewrite bin1.
598	transitivity ((t - 0)%:R + (-1 : int) *+ (2 * (t - 1)) + (t - 2)%N%:R : int).
599	  rewrite 3!big_ord_recl big_ord0 addr0 -!exprnP /=.
600	  by rewrite expr0 !exprS expr0 mulr1 mulrN1 opprK !mulr1n -mulrnA addrA (mulnC 2).
601	rewrite subn0; case: t => [|[|[|t]]] /=.
602	- by rewrite !muln0 !mulr0n !add0r.
603	- by rewrite !muln0 !mulr0n addr0.
604	- rewrite !muln1 !mulr0n addr0.
605	  have -> : (-1 : int) *+ 2 = -1 + -1 by rewrite mulr2n.
606	  have -> : (2%N)%:R = 1 + 1 :> int by rewrite (_ : (2 = 1 + 1)%N) // natrD.
607	  by rewrite !addrA addrK addrN.
608	- have -> : (2 * t.+2 = t.+3 + t.+1)%N by rewrite mul2n -addnn addSnnS addnC.
609	  rewrite mulrnDr !mulNrn -[(t.+3 == 1)%:Z]/(0 : int).
610	  by rewrite !addrA addrN add0r addNr.
611	Qed.
612	
613	(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
614	(* Closed form (Eulerian explicit formula) — TODO                             *)
615	(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
616	(*                                                                            *)
617	(* Given aux_id, the proof of eulerian_explicit follows by Worpitzky          *)
618	(* inversion:                                                                 *)
619	(*                                                                            *)
620	(* RHS = sum_(j < k.+1) (-1)^j *+ C(n+2, j) *+ (k+1-j)^(n+1)                  *)
621	(*     = sum_j (-1)^j *+ C(n+2, j) *+ sum_m eulerian n m * C(k+1-j+m, n+1)    *)
622	(*       [Worpitzky at x = k+1-j]                                             *)
623	(*     = sum_m eulerian n m *+ K(n, k, m)                                     *)
624	(*       [exchange_big]                                                       *)
625	(*  where K(n, k, m) := sum_j (-1)^j *+ C(n+2, j) *+ C(k+1+m-j, n+1)          *)
626	(*                    = aux_id(n, k+1+m)  [extending sum bound]               *)
627	(*                    = (k+1+m == n+1)%:Z = [m == n - k]                      *)
628	(*     = eulerian n (n-k)%:Z                                                  *)
629	(*     = eulerian n k       [eulerian_symm].                                  *)
630	
631	Lemma eulerian_explicit n k :
632	  (eulerian n k)%:Z =
633	    \sum_(j < k.+1) (-1) ^ j *+ 'C(n.+2, j) *+ (k.+1 - j) ^ n.+1.
634	Proof.
635	under eq_bigr => j _ do rewrite -mulr_natr -mulr_natr worpitzky natr_sum big_distrr /=.
636	rewrite exchange_big /=.
637	under eq_bigr => m _.
638	  rewrite (eq_bigr (fun j : 'I_k.+1 => (eulerian n m)%:R *
639	                     ((-1) ^ j * 'C(n.+2, j)%:R * 'C(k.+1 - j + m, n.+1)%:R)));
640	    last by move=> j _; rewrite natrM mulrCA -!mulrA mulrCA.
641	  rewrite -big_distrr /=.
642	  rewrite (eq_bigr (fun i : 'I_k.+1 =>
643	    (-1 : int) ^ i *+ 'C(n.+2, i) *+ 'C(k.+1 + m - i, n.+1)));
644	    last by move=> i _; rewrite !mulr_natr; do 2 f_equal;
645	            rewrite -addnBAC // ltnW // ltn_ord.
646	  over.
647	have inner_eq : forall m, m < n.+1 ->
648	  \sum_(i < k.+1) (-1 : int)^i *+ 'C(n.+2, i) *+ 'C(k.+1 + m - i, n.+1) =
649	  (k.+1 + m == n.+1)%:Z.
650	  move=> m Hm; rewrite -(aux_id n (k.+1 + m)).
651	  pose F (i : nat) := (-1 : int)^i *+ 'C(n.+2, i) *+ 'C(k.+1 + m - i, n.+1).
652	  rewrite -[LHS]/(\sum_(i < k.+1) F i) -[RHS]/(\sum_(i < n.+3) F i).
653	  pose N := maxn k.+1 n.+3.
654	  rewrite (big_ord_widen N F (leq_maxl _ _)) (big_ord_widen N F (leq_maxr _ _)).
655	  rewrite big_mkcond [RHS]big_mkcond /=; apply: eq_bigr => i _ /=; rewrite /F.
656	  case Hin: (i < n.+3); case Hik: (i < k.+1) => //=.
657	  - rewrite (_ : 'C(k.+1 + m - i, n.+1) = 0)%N ?mulr0n //.
658	    by apply/bin_small/(leq_ltn_trans _ Hm); rewrite leq_subLR leq_add2r leqNgt Hik.
659	  - by rewrite (_ : 'C(n.+2, i) = 0)%N ?mulr0n ?mul0rn //; apply: bin_small; rewrite leqNgt Hin.
660	under eq_bigr => m _ do rewrite (inner_eq m (ltn_ord m)).
661	case: (leqP k n) => Hkn; last first.
662	  rewrite eulerian_out_of_range // big1 // => i _.
663	  rewrite (_ : (k.+1 + i == n.+1) = false) ?mulr0 //.
664	  apply/negbTE; rewrite neq_ltn; apply/orP; right.
665	  by rewrite ltnS (leq_trans Hkn) // leq_addr.
666	have HmO : (n - k < n.+1)%N by rewrite ltnS leq_subr.
667	pose m0 := Ordinal HmO.
668	rewrite (bigD1 m0) //= [in (k.+1 + m0 == n.+1)%N]/m0 /= addSn addnC subnK // eqxx mulr1.
669	rewrite big1 ?addr0 ?(eulerian_symm Hkn) ?natz // => i Hi.

671	apply: contraNF Hi => /eqP H; apply/eqP/val_inj => /=.

(* Layer 3: Eulerian numbers and their properties. *)
From mathcomp Require Import all_ssreflect fingroup perm binomial ssrint ssralg.
From mathcomp_eulerian Require Import ordinal_reindex perm_compress descent.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Unset Strict Implicit.
Unset Printing Implicit Defensive.

(* ========================================================================= *)
(* Eulerian numbers                                                          *)
(* ========================================================================= *)

(* eulerian n k = number of permutations of 'I_n.+1 with exactly k descents. *)
Definition eulerian (n k : nat) : nat :=
  #|[set s : {perm 'I_n.+1} | des s == k]|.

(* ========================================================================= *)
(* Base cases and bounds                                                     *)
(* ========================================================================= *)

Section EulerianBasic.

Lemma eulerian_row_sum n : \sum_(k < n.+1) eulerian n k = #|{perm 'I_n.+1}|.
Proof.
rewrite /eulerian -sum1_card.
rewrite (partition_big (fun s : {perm 'I_n.+1} => inord (des s) : 'I_n.+1) xpredT) //=.
apply: eq_bigr => k _; rewrite -sum1_card; apply: eq_bigl => s; rewrite inE.
by rewrite -val_eqE /= inordK // ltnS des_le.
Qed.

Lemma eulerian_row_sum_fact n : \sum_(k < n.+1) eulerian n k = n.+1`!.
Proof. by rewrite eulerian_row_sum card_Sn. Qed.

Lemma eulerian_out_of_range n k : n < k -> eulerian n k = 0.
Proof.
move=> nk; apply/eqP; rewrite cards_eq0; apply/eqP/setP => s.
rewrite !inE; apply/negbTE; rewrite neq_ltn.
by rewrite (leq_ltn_trans (des_le s) nk).
Qed.

Lemma des0_id n (s : {perm 'I_n.+1}) : des s = 0 -> s = 1%g.
Proof.
move=> Hds.
have Hds0 : descent_set s = set0.
  by apply/eqP; rewrite -cards_eq0; apply/eqP.
have Hmono : forall i : 'I_n,
    (val (s (widen_ord (leqnSn n) i)) < val (s (lift ord0 i)))%N.
  move=> i.
  have Hneq : widen_ord (leqnSn n) i != lift ord0 i.
    by apply/eqP => /(congr1 val) /=; rewrite /bump /= add1n => /n_Sn.
  have : i \notin descent_set s by rewrite Hds0 inE.
  rewrite mem_descent_set /is_descent -leqNgt ltn_neqAle => -> /=.
  by rewrite andbT; apply/eqP => /val_inj/perm_inj/eqP; apply/negP.
have Hle : forall i : 'I_n.+1, (val i <= val (s i))%N.
  case=> m; elim: m => [|m IHm] Hm; first exact: leq0n.
  have Hm1 : m < n.+1 by apply: ltnW.
  have Hmn : m < n by [].
  have := Hmono (Ordinal Hmn).
  have -> : widen_ord (leqnSn n) (Ordinal Hmn) = Ordinal Hm1.
    exact: val_inj.
  have -> : lift ord0 (Ordinal Hmn) = Ordinal Hm.
    by apply: val_inj; rewrite /= /bump /= add1n.
  by move/(leq_ltn_trans (IHm Hm1)).
have Hsum : \sum_(i : 'I_n.+1) (val (s i) - val i)%N = 0.
  rewrite sumnB //.
  have -> : \sum_(i : 'I_n.+1) val (s i)
          = \sum_(i : 'I_n.+1) val i.
    by rewrite [RHS](reindex_inj (@perm_inj _ s)).
  by rewrite subnn.
apply/permP => i; rewrite perm1; apply/val_inj.
move/eqP: Hsum; rewrite (bigD1 i) //= addn_eq0 subn_eq0 => /andP[/eqP Hi _].
by apply/eqP; rewrite eqn_leq Hle /= -subn_eq0 Hi.
Qed.

Lemma eulerian_n_0 n : eulerian n 0 = 1.
Proof.
rewrite /eulerian -(cards1 (1%g : {perm 'I_n.+1})); apply: eq_card => s.
rewrite !inE; apply/eqP/eqP => [/des0_id //|->]; exact: des_id.
Qed.

End EulerianBasic.

(* ========================================================================= *)
(* Symmetry: eulerian n k = eulerian n (n - k)                               *)
(* ========================================================================= *)

Lemma rev_perm_inj n : injective (@rev_perm n).
Proof. by move=> s1 s2; rewrite /rev_perm; exact: mulgI. Qed.

Lemma rev_perm_involutive n : involutive (@rev_perm n).
Proof.
move=> s; apply/permP => j.
by rewrite !rev_permE rev_ordK.
Qed.

Lemma eulerian_symm n k : k <= n -> eulerian n k = eulerian n (n - k).
Proof.
move=> kn; rewrite /eulerian.
rewrite -(card_imset _ (@rev_perm_inj n)).
congr #|pred_of_set _|; apply/setP => s; rewrite !inE.
apply/imsetP/idP.
+ by case=> t; rewrite inE => /eqP <- ->; rewrite des_rev_perm.
+ move=> /eqP Hs; exists (rev_perm s); last by rewrite rev_perm_involutive.
  by rewrite inE des_rev_perm Hs subKn.
Qed.

Lemma eulerian_n_n n : eulerian n n = 1.
Proof. by rewrite (eulerian_symm (leqnn n)) subnn eulerian_n_0. Qed.

(* ========================================================================= *)
(* Recurrence:                                                               *)
(*   eulerian n.+1 k.+1 = k.+2 * eulerian n k.+1 + (n.+1 - k) * eulerian n k *)
(* (The k = 0 case is eulerian_n_0: eulerian n.+1 0 = 1.)                    *)
(*                                                                           *)
(* We prove this via the "insert-max-value" bijection                        *)
(*   {perm 'I_n.+2} ≅ {perm 'I_n.+1} × 'I_n.+2                               *)
(*   σ ↦ (τ, p)                                                              *)
(* where p = σ^{-1}(ord_max) is the position of the max value and τ is       *)
(* obtained by deleting that max from σ's one-line notation.                 *)
(* ========================================================================= *)

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Helpers on widen_ord (leqnSn n.+1) : 'I_n.+1 -> 'I_n.+2                   *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

Lemma widenSn_inj n : injective (widen_ord (leqnSn n.+1)).
Proof. by move=> i1 i2 H; apply/val_inj; exact: (congr1 val H). Qed.

Lemma widenSn_neq_ord_max n (j : 'I_n.+1) :
  widen_ord (leqnSn n.+1) j != (ord_max : 'I_n.+2).
Proof.
by apply/eqP => H; move: (congr1 val H) (ltn_ord j) => /= ->; rewrite ltnn.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* insert_max_perm: inserting max value at a given position                  *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

Section InsertMax.
Variables (n : nat) (t : {perm 'I_n.+1}) (p : 'I_n.+2).

Definition insert_max_fun (i : 'I_n.+2) : 'I_n.+2 :=
  match unlift p i with
  | Some j => widen_ord (leqnSn _) (t j)
  | None => ord_max
  end.

Lemma insert_max_fun_p : insert_max_fun p = ord_max.
Proof. by rewrite /insert_max_fun unlift_none. Qed.

Lemma insert_max_fun_lift (j : 'I_n.+1) :
  insert_max_fun (lift p j) = widen_ord (leqnSn _) (t j).
Proof. by rewrite /insert_max_fun liftK. Qed.

Lemma insert_max_fun_inj : injective insert_max_fun.
Proof.
move=> i1 i2; rewrite /insert_max_fun.
case: (unliftP p i1) => [j1 ->|->]; case: (unliftP p i2) => [j2 ->|->].
- by move/widenSn_inj/perm_inj ->.
- by move/eqP; rewrite (negbTE (widenSn_neq_ord_max _)).
- by move/eqP; rewrite eq_sym (negbTE (widenSn_neq_ord_max _)).
- by [].
Qed.

Definition insert_max_perm : {perm 'I_n.+2} := perm insert_max_fun_inj.

Lemma insert_max_permE i : insert_max_perm i = insert_max_fun i.
Proof. by rewrite permE. Qed.

Lemma insert_max_perm_at_p : insert_max_perm p = ord_max.
Proof. by rewrite insert_max_permE insert_max_fun_p. Qed.

Lemma insert_max_perm_lift (j : 'I_n.+1) :
  insert_max_perm (lift p j) = widen_ord (leqnSn _) (t j).
Proof. by rewrite insert_max_permE insert_max_fun_lift. Qed.

End InsertMax.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Inverse: extract_max_perm                                                *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

Section ExtractMax.
Variables (n : nat) (s : {perm 'I_n.+2}) (p : 'I_n.+2).
Hypothesis (sp : s p = ord_max).

Fact extract_max_ne (j : 'I_n.+1) : s (lift p j) != (ord_max : 'I_n.+2).
Proof.
rewrite -sp; apply/eqP => /perm_inj /eqP.
by rewrite eq_sym (negbTE (neq_lift _ _)).
Qed.

Definition extract_max_fun (j : 'I_n.+1) : 'I_n.+1 :=
  odflt j (unlift ord_max (s (lift p j))).

Lemma extract_max_funE (j : 'I_n.+1) :
  widen_ord (leqnSn n.+1) (extract_max_fun j) = s (lift p j).
Proof.
rewrite /extract_max_fun.
case: (unliftP ord_max (s (lift p j))) => [k ->|H] /=.
- by apply: val_inj; rewrite /= /bump /= leqNgt ltn_ord.
- by move: (extract_max_ne j); rewrite H eqxx.
Qed.

Lemma extract_max_fun_inj : injective extract_max_fun.
Proof.
move=> j1 j2 /(congr1 (widen_ord (leqnSn n.+1))).
rewrite !extract_max_funE => /perm_inj /lift_inj //.
Qed.

Definition extract_max_perm : {perm 'I_n.+1} := perm extract_max_fun_inj.

Lemma extract_max_permE j : extract_max_perm j = extract_max_fun j.
Proof. by rewrite permE. Qed.

Lemma extract_max_widen (j : 'I_n.+1) :
  widen_ord (leqnSn n.+1) (extract_max_perm j) = s (lift p j).
Proof. by rewrite extract_max_permE extract_max_funE. Qed.

End ExtractMax.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Bijection: insert_max_perm and extract_max_perm are inverses             *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

Section InsertExtractBij.
Variable n : nat.

Lemma extract_insert_max (t : {perm 'I_n.+1}) (p : 'I_n.+2) :
  extract_max_perm (insert_max_perm_at_p t p) = t.
Proof.
apply/permP => j; apply: (@widenSn_inj n).
by rewrite (extract_max_widen (insert_max_perm_at_p _ _)) insert_max_perm_lift.
Qed.

Lemma insert_extract_max (s : {perm 'I_n.+2}) (p : 'I_n.+2)
    (sp : s p = ord_max) :
  insert_max_perm (extract_max_perm sp) p = s.
Proof.
apply/permP => i; rewrite insert_max_permE /insert_max_fun.
case: (unliftP p i) => [j ->|->]; last exact/esym.
by rewrite -extract_max_widen.
Qed.

End InsertExtractBij.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Descent count under insertion                                            *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

Section DesInsertMax.
Variables (n : nat) (t : {perm 'I_n.+1}).

Lemma des_insert_max_ord0 :
  des (insert_max_perm t ord0) = (des t).+1.
Proof.
rewrite /des /descent_set.
suff -> : [set i : 'I_n.+1 | is_descent (insert_max_perm t ord0) i]
        = (ord0 : 'I_n.+1) |: [set lift ord0 j | j in [set i | is_descent t i]].
  rewrite cardsU1 card_imset; last exact: lift_inj.
  have -> : ord0 \notin [set lift ord0 j | j in [set i | is_descent t i]].
    apply/imsetP => -[x _ Hx].
    by have := neq_lift ord0 x; rewrite -Hx eqxx.
  by rewrite add1n.
apply/setP => i; rewrite !inE.
case: (unliftP ord0 i) => [j ->|->].
- rewrite eq_sym (negbTE (neq_lift _ _)) /=.
  have E1 : widen_ord (leqnSn n.+1) (lift ord0 j)
          = lift ord0 (widen_ord (leqnSn n) j) :> 'I_n.+2.
    by apply/val_inj; rewrite /= /bump leq0n /= add1n.
  rewrite /is_descent E1 !insert_max_perm_lift.
  apply/idP/imsetP.
  + by move=> H; exists j; first by rewrite inE /is_descent.
  + by case=> j' /[!inE] Hj' /lift_inj ->; rewrite /is_descent.
- rewrite eqxx orTb /is_descent.
  have -> : widen_ord (leqnSn n.+1) (ord0 : 'I_n.+1) = ord0 :> 'I_n.+2.
    by apply/val_inj.
  by rewrite insert_max_perm_at_p insert_max_perm_lift /=; apply: ltn_ord.
Qed.

Lemma des_insert_max_ord_max :
  des (insert_max_perm t (ord_max : 'I_n.+2)) = des t.
Proof.
rewrite /des /descent_set.
suff -> : [set i : 'I_n.+1 | is_descent (insert_max_perm t ord_max) i]
        = [set (lift ord_max j : 'I_n.+1) | j in [set i : 'I_n | is_descent t i]].
  by rewrite card_imset //; exact: lift_inj.
apply/setP => i; rewrite !inE.
case: (unliftP ord_max i) => [j ->|->].
- have E1 : widen_ord (leqnSn n.+1) (lift ord_max j)
          = lift ord_max (widen_ord (leqnSn n) j) :> 'I_n.+2.
    apply/val_inj; rewrite /= /bump /=.
    rewrite leqNgt (ltn_ord j) /=.
    by rewrite leqNgt (leq_trans (ltn_ord j) (leqnSn n)).
  have E2 : lift ord0 (lift ord_max j : 'I_n.+1)
          = lift ord_max (lift ord0 j) :> 'I_n.+2.
    apply/val_inj => /=.
    rewrite /bump /=.
    have H2 : (n <= j) = false by apply/negbTE; rewrite -ltnNge; apply: ltn_ord.
    have H3 : (n.+1 <= j.+1) = false by apply/negbTE; rewrite -ltnNge; apply: ltn_ord.
    by rewrite H2 H3.
  rewrite /is_descent E1 E2 !insert_max_perm_lift.
  apply/idP/imsetP.
  + by move=> H; exists j; first by rewrite inE /is_descent.
  + by case=> j' /[!inE] Hj' /lift_inj ->; rewrite /is_descent.
- rewrite /is_descent.
  have E1 : widen_ord (leqnSn n.+1) (ord_max : 'I_n.+1)
          = lift ord_max (ord_max : 'I_n.+1) :> 'I_n.+2.
    by apply/val_inj; rewrite /= /bump /= leqNgt ltnSn.
  have -> : lift ord0 (ord_max : 'I_n.+1) = ord_max :> 'I_n.+2.
    by apply/val_inj.
  rewrite E1 insert_max_perm_lift insert_max_perm_at_p.
  apply/idP/imsetP.
  + by move=> H; move: (ltn_ord (t (ord_max : 'I_n.+1)));
       rewrite ltnNge /= in H; case/negP: H; apply: ltnW.
  + case=> j _ /eqP; rewrite -val_eqE /= /bump /= leqNgt ltn_ord /= => /eqP eqn.
    rewrite add0n in eqn.
    by move: (ltn_ord j); rewrite -eqn ltnn.
Qed.

Lemma des_insert_max_interior (j : 'I_n) :
  des (insert_max_perm t (lift ord0 (widen_ord (leqnSn n) j))) =
    des t + ~~ is_descent t j.
Proof.
set h := widen_ord (leqnSn n) j.
set p := lift ord0 h.
set sigma := insert_max_perm t p.
rewrite /des /descent_set.
suff -> : [set i | is_descent sigma i]
        = [set lift h x | x in [set y | is_descent t y] :|: [set j]].
  rewrite card_imset; last exact: lift_inj.
  rewrite setUC cardsU1 inE /=.
  by case: (is_descent t j); rewrite addnC.
apply/setP => i; rewrite !inE.
case: (unliftP h i) => [x ->|->].
- (* Goal: is_descent σ (lift h x) = x ∈ descent_set t ∪ {j} (up to lift h) *)
  have sigma_lift0 : forall x : 'I_n,
    sigma (lift ord0 (lift h x)) = widen_ord (leqnSn n.+1) (t (lift ord0 x)).
    move=> y.
    have E : lift ord0 (lift h y) = lift p (lift ord0 y) :> 'I_n.+2.
      by apply/val_inj => /=; rewrite /p /=; rewrite /bump /= addnCA.
    by rewrite /sigma E insert_max_perm_lift.
  have -> : (lift h x \in [set lift h x0 | x0 in [set y | is_descent t y] :|: [set j]])
          = (is_descent t x) || (x == j).
    apply/imsetP/idP => [[y]|].
    + by rewrite !inE => /orP[Hy|/eqP ->] /lift_inj ->;
         [rewrite Hy|rewrite eqxx orbT].
    + case/orP => [H|/eqP ->].
      - by exists x; rewrite // !inE H.
      - by exists j; rewrite // !inE eqxx orbT.
  rewrite /is_descent sigma_lift0 /=.
  case: (eqVneq x j) => [->|xnj].
  + have -> : sigma (widen_ord (leqnSn n.+1) (lift h j)) = ord_max.
      have E : widen_ord (leqnSn n.+1) (lift h j) = p :> 'I_n.+2.
        by apply/val_inj; rewrite /= /p /= /bump /= leqnn.
      by rewrite /sigma E insert_max_perm_at_p.
    by rewrite orbT; apply: ltn_ord.
  + rewrite orbF.
    have E : widen_ord (leqnSn n.+1) (lift h x) = lift p (widen_ord (leqnSn n) x) :> 'I_n.+2.
      apply/val_inj; rewrite /= /p /= /bump /=.
      case: (ltngtP x j) => [Hxj|Hxj|Hxj].
      - by [].
      - by [].
      - by rewrite -val_eqE /= Hxj eqxx in xnj.
    by rewrite /sigma E insert_max_perm_lift.
- (* Goal: is_descent σ h = h ∈ image (false) *)
  have Rfalse : (h \in [set lift h x | x in [set y | is_descent t y] :|: [set j]]) = false.
    by apply/negbTE/imsetP => -[y _ Hy]; have := neq_lift h y; rewrite -Hy eqxx.
  rewrite Rfalse /is_descent.
  have E1 : widen_ord (leqnSn n.+1) h = lift p h :> 'I_n.+2.
    apply/val_inj; rewrite /= /p /= /bump /=.
    by rewrite add1n ltnn.
  have E2 : lift ord0 h = p :> 'I_n.+2 by [].
  rewrite E1 E2 insert_max_perm_lift insert_max_perm_at_p.
  apply/negbTE; rewrite -leqNgt.
  by apply: ltnW; rewrite /=; exact: ltn_ord.
Qed.

End DesInsertMax.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Bijection on fibers: {σ : σ^{-1} ord_max = p} ≃ {perm 'I_n.+1}           *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

Lemma insert_max_perm_fiber n (p : 'I_n.+2) (t : {perm 'I_n.+1}) :
  ((insert_max_perm t p)^-1)%g ord_max = p.
Proof.
apply: (@perm_inj _ (insert_max_perm t p)).
by rewrite permKV insert_max_perm_at_p.
Qed.

Lemma insert_max_perm_pair_inj n :
  injective (fun tp : {perm 'I_n.+1} * 'I_n.+2 => insert_max_perm tp.1 tp.2).
Proof.
move=> [t1 p1] [t2 p2] /= E.
have Ep : p1 = p2.
  by rewrite -(insert_max_perm_fiber p1 t1) -(insert_max_perm_fiber p2 t2) E.
move: E; rewrite Ep => E.
congr (_, _); apply/permP => i; apply: (@widenSn_inj n).
have := congr1 (fun s : {perm 'I_n.+2} => s (lift p2 i)) E.
by rewrite !insert_max_perm_lift.
Qed.

Lemma insert_max_perm_pair_surj n (s : {perm 'I_n.+2}) :
  exists tp : {perm 'I_n.+1} * 'I_n.+2, s = insert_max_perm tp.1 tp.2.
Proof.
pose p : 'I_n.+2 := (s^-1)%g ord_max.
have sp : s p = ord_max by rewrite /p permKV.
exists (extract_max_perm sp, p) => /=.
by rewrite (insert_extract_max sp).
Qed.

Lemma sum_descent n (t : {perm 'I_n.+1}) :
  \sum_(j : 'I_n) is_descent t j = des t.
Proof.
rewrite /des /descent_set -sum1dep_card [RHS]big_mkcond /=.
by apply: eq_bigr => j _; case: (is_descent t j).
Qed.

Lemma sum_ascent n (t : {perm 'I_n.+1}) :
  \sum_(j : 'I_n) ~~ is_descent t j = n - des t.
Proof.
apply/eqP; rewrite -(eqn_add2l (des t)) subnKC ?des_le //.
rewrite -sum_descent -big_split /=.
rewrite (eq_bigr (fun _ => 1)); last by move=> j _; case: (is_descent t j).
by rewrite sum_nat_const card_ord muln1.
Qed.

Lemma extract_insert_maxPI n (t : {perm 'I_n.+1}) (p : 'I_n.+2)
  (sp : insert_max_perm t p p = ord_max) :
  extract_max_perm sp = t.
Proof.
apply/permP => j; apply: (@widenSn_inj n).
by rewrite extract_max_widen insert_max_perm_lift.
Qed.

Lemma insert_max_perm_bij n :
  bijective (fun tp : {perm 'I_n.+1} * 'I_n.+2 => insert_max_perm tp.1 tp.2).
Proof.
pose g (s : {perm 'I_n.+2}) : {perm 'I_n.+1} * 'I_n.+2 :=
  (extract_max_perm (permKV s ord_max), (s^-1)%g ord_max).
exists g.
- move=> [t p] /=; rewrite /g /=.
  (* First extract p *)
  congr pair; last exact: insert_max_perm_fiber.
  apply/permP => j; apply: (@widenSn_inj n).
  rewrite extract_max_widen.
  have E : lift ((insert_max_perm t p)^-1%g ord_max) j = lift p j :> 'I_n.+2.
    by apply/val_inj; rewrite /= insert_max_perm_fiber.
  by rewrite E insert_max_perm_lift.
- move=> s /=; rewrite /g; exact: insert_extract_max.
Qed.

Lemma eulerian_rec n k :
  eulerian n.+1 k.+1 = k.+2 * eulerian n k.+1 + (n.+1 - k) * eulerian n k.
Proof.
rewrite /eulerian -sum1dep_card.
rewrite (reindex _ (onW_bij _ (insert_max_perm_bij n))) /=.
rewrite -(pair_big_dep xpredT
            (fun t p => des (insert_max_perm t p) == k.+1)
            (fun _ _ => 1)) /=.
under eq_bigr => t _ do rewrite big_mkcond /=.
under eq_bigr => t _ do rewrite big_ord_recl big_ord_recr /=.
have lom : lift ord0 (ord_max : 'I_n.+1) = (ord_max : 'I_n.+2) by apply/val_inj.
under eq_bigr => t _ do rewrite lom.
under eq_bigr => t _ do rewrite des_insert_max_ord0 des_insert_max_ord_max.
under eq_bigr => t _ do under eq_bigr => i _ do rewrite des_insert_max_interior.
under eq_bigr => t _.
  rewrite (bigID (fun i : 'I_n => is_descent t i)) /=.
  under eq_bigr => i Hi do rewrite Hi addn0.
  under [X in _ + X + _]eq_bigr => i Hi do rewrite (negbTE Hi) addn1.
  over.
under eq_bigr => t _ do rewrite !eqSS.
under eq_bigr => t _ do rewrite sum_nat_cond_const sum_nat_cond_const.
under eq_bigr => t _ do rewrite -/(descent_set t) -/(des t).
have asc_card (u : {perm 'I_n.+1}) : #|[set x | ~~ is_descent u x]| = n - des u.
  have -> : [set x | ~~ is_descent u x] = ~: [set x | is_descent u x].
    by apply/setP => i; rewrite !inE.
  by rewrite cardsCs setCK card_ord.
under eq_bigr => t _ do rewrite asc_card.
rewrite -!sum1dep_card !big_distrr /=.
rewrite [X in _ = _ + X]big_mkcond /= [X in _ = X + _]big_mkcond /= -big_split /=.
apply: eq_bigr => t _; rewrite !muln1.
case E1: (des t == k); case E2: (des t == k.+1); rewrite /= ?addn0 ?add0n ?mul0n ?muln0.
- move/eqP: E1 E2 => ->; move/eqP => Habs.
  by exfalso; move: (ltnSn k); rewrite {1}Habs ltnn.
- move/eqP: E1 => <-.
  by rewrite add0n muln1 add1n subSn //; apply: des_le.
- by move/eqP: E2 => ->; rewrite muln1 addn0 addn1.
- by [].
Qed.

(* ========================================================================= *)
(* Worpitzky's identity                                                       *)
(*   x^(n+1) = \sum_(k < n+1) eulerian n k * C(x+k, n+1)                      *)
(* ========================================================================= *)

(* Key algebraic identity (valid for k <= n): *)
(*   x * C(x+k, n+1) = (k+1) * C(x+k, n+2) + (n+1-k) * C(x+k+1, n+2)         *)
Lemma worpitzky_binom_id x k n : k <= n ->
  x * 'C(x + k, n.+1) =
    k.+1 * 'C(x + k, n.+2) + (n.+1 - k) * 'C(x + k.+1, n.+2).
Proof.
move=> kle.
rewrite addnS binS mulnDr addnA -mulnDl.
have -> : k.+1 + (n.+1 - k) = n.+2 by rewrite addSn subnKC// ltnW.
rewrite mul_bin_left -mulnDl.
case: (leqP n.+1 (x + k)) => h.
- symmetry; rewrite addnBA; first by rewrite subnK // addnK.
  exact: ltnW.
- by rewrite !bin_small ?muln0 //; exact: (leq_trans h (leqnSn _)).
Qed.

Lemma worpitzky n x :
  x ^ n.+1 = \sum_(k < n.+1) eulerian n k * 'C(x + k, n.+1).
Proof.
elim: n x => [|n IH] x.
  by rewrite big_ord1 eulerian_n_0 mul1n bin1 addn0 expn1.
rewrite expnS IH big_distrr /=.
under eq_bigr => k _.
  rewrite mulnA (mulnC x) -mulnA.
  rewrite (worpitzky_binom_id _ _ (n := n)); last by rewrite -ltnS.
  rewrite mulnDr.
  over.
rewrite big_split /=.
rewrite big_ord_recl eulerian_n_0 mul1n addn0.
rewrite [RHS]big_ord_recl eulerian_n_0 mul1n addn0.
under [X in _ = _ + X]eq_bigr => i _ do rewrite eulerian_rec mulnDl.
rewrite big_split /=.
rewrite mul1n -addnA.
congr (_ + _).
congr (_ + _); last first.
- by apply: eq_bigr => i _; rewrite mulnCA /bump /= add1n mulnA.
rewrite [RHS]big_ord_recr /= eulerian_out_of_range ?ltnSn // muln0 mul0n addn0.
apply: eq_bigr => i _.
by rewrite /bump /= !add1n mulnCA mulnA.
Qed.

(* ========================================================================= *)
(* Closed form (Eulerian explicit formula):                                   *)
(*   eulerian n k = \sum_(j <= k) (-1)^j C(n+2, j) (k+1-j)^(n+1)  [in int]    *)
(* ========================================================================= *)

Import GRing.Theory.
Local Open Scope ring_scope.

(* Alternating binomial convolution identity.                                *)
(* \sum_j (-1)^j C(n+2, j) C(t-j, n+1) = [t == n+1]                          *)

(* Signed Pascal extension: works uniformly even when subtraction saturates. *)
Lemma binS' t n : 'C(t, n.+2) = 'C(t.-1, n.+2) + 'C(t.-1, n.+1).
Proof. by case: t => [|t]//=; rewrite binS. Qed.

(* Key recurrence for the alternating sum: g(N+1, u) = g(N, u.-1).           *)
(* Proved via Pascal applied to both binomial factors plus reindex.          *)
Lemma aux_id_step (N u : nat) :
  \sum_(j < N.+4) (-1 : int) ^ j *+ 'C(N.+3, j) *+ 'C(u - j, N.+2) =
  \sum_(j < N.+3) (-1 : int) ^ j *+ 'C(N.+2, j) *+ 'C(u.-1 - j, N.+1).
Proof.
rewrite big_ord_recl [(-1) ^ ord0]expr0 bin0 mulr1n subn0.
under eq_bigr => i _ do rewrite binS mulrnDr mulrnDl.
rewrite big_split /=.
have beta_eq :
  \sum_(i < N.+3) ((-1 : int) ^ i.+1 *+ 'C(N.+2, i) *+ 'C(u - i.+1, N.+2)) =
  - \sum_(i < N.+3) ((-1 : int) ^ i *+ 'C(N.+2, i) *+ 'C(u.-1 - i, N.+2)).
  rewrite -sumrN; apply: eq_bigr => i _.
  by case: u => [|u']//=; rewrite exprSz mulN1r !mulNrn.
have alpha_eq :
  ('C(u, N.+2)%:R : int) +
  \sum_(i < N.+3) ((-1 : int) ^ i.+1 *+ 'C(N.+2, i.+1) *+ 'C(u - i.+1, N.+2)) =
  \sum_(j < N.+4) ((-1 : int) ^ j *+ 'C(N.+2, j) *+ 'C(u - j, N.+2)).
  rewrite [RHS]big_ord_recl [(-1) ^ ord0]expr0 bin0 mulr1n subn0.
  by congr (_ + _); apply: eq_bigr => i _.
rewrite addrA alpha_eq [\sum_(j < N.+4) _]big_ord_recr /= bin_small // mul0rn addr0 beta_eq.
rewrite -[_ + - _]/(_ - _) -sumrB; apply: eq_bigr => i _.
have aux v : ((v - i).-1 = v.-1 - i)%N by case: v => [|v']//=; rewrite -subnS.
by rewrite (binS' (u - i) N) (aux u) mulrnDr addrAC subrr add0r.
Qed.

Lemma aux_id (n t : nat) :
  \sum_(j < n.+3) (-1) ^ j *+ 'C(n.+2, j) *+ 'C(t - j, n.+1) =
  (t == n.+1)%:Z.
Proof.
elim: n t => [|n IH] t; last by rewrite aux_id_step IH; case: t.
under eq_bigr => j _ do rewrite bin1.
transitivity ((t - 0)%:R + (-1 : int) *+ (2 * (t - 1)) + (t - 2)%N%:R : int).
  rewrite 3!big_ord_recl big_ord0 addr0 -!exprnP /=.
  by rewrite expr0 !exprS expr0 mulr1 mulrN1 opprK !mulr1n -mulrnA addrA (mulnC 2).
rewrite subn0; case: t => [|[|[|t]]] /=.
- by rewrite !muln0 !mulr0n !add0r.
- by rewrite !muln0 !mulr0n addr0.
- rewrite !muln1 !mulr0n addr0.
  have -> : (-1 : int) *+ 2 = -1 + -1 by rewrite mulr2n.
  have -> : (2%N)%:R = 1 + 1 :> int by rewrite (_ : (2 = 1 + 1)%N) // natrD.
  by rewrite !addrA addrK addrN.
- have -> : (2 * t.+2 = t.+3 + t.+1)%N by rewrite mul2n -addnn addSnnS addnC.
  rewrite mulrnDr !mulNrn -[(t.+3 == 1)%:Z]/(0 : int).
  by rewrite !addrA addrN add0r addNr.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Closed form (Eulerian explicit formula) — TODO                             *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(*                                                                            *)
(* Given aux_id, the proof of eulerian_explicit follows by Worpitzky          *)
(* inversion:                                                                 *)
(*                                                                            *)
(* RHS = sum_(j < k.+1) (-1)^j *+ C(n+2, j) *+ (k+1-j)^(n+1)                  *)
(*     = sum_j (-1)^j *+ C(n+2, j) *+ sum_m eulerian n m * C(k+1-j+m, n+1)    *)
(*       [Worpitzky at x = k+1-j]                                             *)
(*     = sum_m eulerian n m *+ K(n, k, m)                                     *)
(*       [exchange_big]                                                       *)
(*  where K(n, k, m) := sum_j (-1)^j *+ C(n+2, j) *+ C(k+1+m-j, n+1)          *)
(*                    = aux_id(n, k+1+m)  [extending sum bound]               *)
(*                    = (k+1+m == n+1)%:Z = [m == n - k]                      *)
(*     = eulerian n (n-k)%:Z                                                  *)
(*     = eulerian n k       [eulerian_symm].                                  *)

Lemma eulerian_explicit n k :
  (eulerian n k)%:Z =
    \sum_(j < k.+1) (-1) ^ j *+ 'C(n.+2, j) *+ (k.+1 - j) ^ n.+1.
Proof.
under eq_bigr => j _ do rewrite -mulr_natr -mulr_natr worpitzky natr_sum big_distrr /=.
rewrite exchange_big /=.
under eq_bigr => m _.
  rewrite (eq_bigr (fun j : 'I_k.+1 => (eulerian n m)%:R *
                     ((-1) ^ j * 'C(n.+2, j)%:R * 'C(k.+1 - j + m, n.+1)%:R)));
    last by move=> j _; rewrite natrM mulrCA -!mulrA mulrCA.
  rewrite -big_distrr /=.
  rewrite (eq_bigr (fun i : 'I_k.+1 =>
    (-1 : int) ^ i *+ 'C(n.+2, i) *+ 'C(k.+1 + m - i, n.+1)));
    last by move=> i _; rewrite !mulr_natr; do 2 f_equal;
            rewrite -addnBAC // ltnW // ltn_ord.
  over.
have inner_eq : forall m, m < n.+1 ->
  \sum_(i < k.+1) (-1 : int)^i *+ 'C(n.+2, i) *+ 'C(k.+1 + m - i, n.+1) =
  (k.+1 + m == n.+1)%:Z.
  move=> m Hm; rewrite -(aux_id n (k.+1 + m)).
  pose F (i : nat) := (-1 : int)^i *+ 'C(n.+2, i) *+ 'C(k.+1 + m - i, n.+1).
  rewrite -[LHS]/(\sum_(i < k.+1) F i) -[RHS]/(\sum_(i < n.+3) F i).
  pose N := maxn k.+1 n.+3.

(* psi_cdindex.v — Milestones 5+6: cd-index and support characterization     *)
(*                                                                           *)
(* Proves Fact #3 (cd-index via ψ) and constructs strict witnesses for the   *)
(* omega-monotonicity of β.                                                  *)

From mathcomp Require Import all_ssreflect.
Require Import mmtree psi_core psi_comm psi_descent_v2 psi_descent_thms.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Unset Strict Implicit.
Unset Printing Implicit Defensive.

(* ===== Milestone 5: Fact #3 — Φ_w(a+b, ab+ba) = Σ_{v∈[w]} u_{D(v)} ====== *)
(* Reference: M5_FACT3_INFORMAL.md (informal proof note).                      *)
(* Stanley EC1 (2nd ed.) section 1.6.3, Fact #3 (lines 294-329).              *)
(* The cd-index of w, evaluated at c:=a+b and d:=ab+ba, equals the sum of     *)
(* characteristic monomials u_{D(v)} over the M-equivalence class [w].        *)

(* ----- M5.0 Definitions ----------------------------------------------------- *)

(* Vertex i is internal (not an endpoint) iff it has window_size > 1. *)
Definition is_internal (i : nat) (w : seq nat) : bool :=
  (i < size w) && (1 < window_size i w).

(* Apply a sequence of psi operators left-to-right. *)
Definition apply_psis (ops : seq nat) (w : seq nat) : seq nat :=
  foldl (fun w' i => psi i w') w ops.

(* Characteristic monomial: the seq of descent bits, true = b, false = a. *)
Definition char_mono (w : seq nat) : seq bool :=
  [seq is_descent_seq w k | k <- iota 0 (size w).-1].

(* The cd-alphabet for classifying internal vertices. *)
Inductive cde := C_letter | D_letter | E_letter.

Definition classify_vertex_cde (i : nat) (w : seq nat) : cde :=
  if ~~ is_internal i w then E_letter
  else if has_left_child i w then D_letter
  else C_letter.

(* Φ'_w: the full classification string (one letter per vertex). *)
Definition phi'_w (w : seq nat) : seq cde :=
  [seq classify_vertex_cde i w | i <- iota 0 (size w)].

(* Φ_w: delete endpoints (set e = 1, the empty word). *)
Definition phi_w (w : seq nat) : seq cde :=
  [seq x <- phi'_w w | match x with E_letter => false | _ => true end].

(* ========================================================================= *)
(* §G. Direct ω-based proof that alt maximises β                             *)
(* ========================================================================= *)

Lemma not_set_is_alt_n_ge2 n (D : {set 'I_n}) :
  ~~ set_is_alt D -> 1 < n.
Proof.
move=> /set_not_altP [i [j [Hj _]]].
have Hjn : (val j < n)%N := ltn_ord j.
rewrite Hj in Hjn.
by apply: leq_ltn_trans Hjn; apply: ltn0Sn.
Qed.

(* ω(alt) is the full set: every consecutive pair in alt_desc_set
   has differing membership, so every position is in the omega set. *)
Lemma omega_set_alt_full m :
  @omega_set m (alt_desc_set m.+1) = [set: 'I_m].
Proof.
apply/setP => k.
have Hk := @mem_omega_set m (alt_desc_set m.+1) k.
rewrite Hk inE.
(* LHS is (widen_ord _ k \in alt_desc_set m.+1) != (lift ord0 k \in ...) *)
(* RHS is true *)
rewrite !inE /=.
(* Now should have ~~ odd (widen ...) != ~~ odd (lift ...) = true *)
(* widen_ord k has val k, lift ord0 k has val k.+1 *)
rewrite /bump /=.
by case: (odd (val k)).
Qed.

(* If D is not set-alternating, then ω(D) is missing at least one element. *)
Lemma not_set_is_alt_omega_not_full m (D : {set 'I_m.+1}) :
  ~~ set_is_alt D -> omega_set D != [set: 'I_m].
Proof.
move/set_not_altP => [i [j [Hj Hij]]].
(* We have i,j consecutive with same membership.
   The omega bit at the position k with widen k = i, lift k = j
   is NOT set (since D(i) = D(j) means same membership). *)
have Hik : val i < m.
  by have := ltn_ord j; rewrite Hj -ltnS.
pose k := Ordinal Hik.
apply/eqP => Hfull.
have : k \in omega_set D by rewrite Hfull inE.
rewrite mem_omega_set.
have Ewid : widen_ord (leqnSn m) k = i by apply/val_inj.
have Elif : lift ord0 k = j by apply/val_inj; rewrite /= /bump /= add1n -Hj.
rewrite Ewid Elif Hij. by rewrite eqxx.
Qed.

(* Main theorem: the alternating descent set maximises β. *)
Lemma beta_alt_max n (D : {set 'I_n}) :
  ~~ set_is_alt D -> beta D < beta (alt_desc_set n).
Proof.
move=> Hnalt.
have Hn2 := not_set_is_alt_n_ge2 Hnalt.
(* Need n >= 2 to apply omega_proper_beta_lt.
   Write n = m.+2 so D : {set 'I_{m.+2}} = {set 'I_{(m.+1).+1}}. *)
case: n D Hnalt Hn2 => [|[|m]] D Hnalt Hn2 //.
(* Now n = m.+2, D : {set 'I_{m.+2}}. *)
apply: (omega_proper_beta_lt (m := m.+1)).
(* omega_set D \proper omega_set (alt_desc_set (m.+2)) *)
rewrite omega_set_alt_full.
(* omega_set D \proper [set: 'I_{m.+1}] *)
apply/properP; split.
- by apply/subsetP => x _; rewrite inE.
- (* omega_set D != setT, so there exists k not in omega_set D *)
  (* Directly from the set_not_altP witness *)
  case: (set_not_altP Hnalt) => i0 [j0 [Hj0 Hij0]].
  have Hik0 : val i0 < m.+1.
    by have := ltn_ord j0; rewrite Hj0 -ltnS.
  pose k0 := Ordinal Hik0.
  have Hk0 : k0 \notin omega_set D.
    rewrite (@mem_omega_set m.+1).
    have Ew : widen_ord (leqnSn m.+1) k0 = i0 by apply/val_inj.
    have El : lift ord0 k0 = j0 by apply/val_inj; rewrite /= /bump /= add1n -Hj0.
    by rewrite Ew El Hij0 eqxx.
  exists k0; first by rewrite inE.
  exact: Hk0.
Qed.

mutation w = w1 w2 · · · wn ∈ Sn (or more generally any sequence of distinct numbers) is
alternating (or zigzag or down-up) if w1 > w2 < w3 > w4 < · · · . Equivalently, D(w) =
{1, 3, 5, . . . } ∩ [n − 1]. The alternating permutations in S4 are 2143, 3142, 3241, 4132, 4231.
Similarly, w is reverse alternating (or up-down) if w1 < w2 > w3 < w4 > · · · . Equivalently,

2314, 2413, 3412. The number of alternating permutations w ∈ Sn is denoted En (with

(the inversion table). In this section we will consider four additional ways of representing
permutations and will illustrate the usefulness of each such representation.
The first representation is the most obvious, viz., a permutation matrix. Specifically, if

retreating elements) of w (i.e., elements wi such that wi < wj for all j < i, where w =
w1 w2 · · · wn ). Moreover, the endpoints of T ′ (w) are just the elements wi for which i ∈ D(w)
or i = n. Thus in analogy to Proposition 1.5.3 (using Proposition 1.3.1 and the obvious
symmetry between left-to-right maxima and left-to-right minima) we obtain the following
result.
1.5.5 Proposition. (a) The number of unordered increasing trees on n + 1 vertices is n!.

 (b) The number of such trees for which the root has k successors is the signless Stirling
     number c(n, k).

 (c) The number of such trees with k endpoints is the Eulerian number A(n, k).

1.6.2     Flip equivalence of increasing binary trees

Alternating permutations appear as the number of equivalence classes of certain naturally de-
fined equivalence relations. (For an example unrelated to this section, see Exercise 3.127(b).)
We will give an archetypal example in this subsection. In the next subsection we will give a
similar result which has an application to the numbers βn (S) of permutations w ∈ Sn with
descent set S.
Recall that in Section 1.5 we associated an increasing binary tree T (w) with a permutation
w ∈ Sn . The flip of a binary tree at a vertex v is the binary tree obtained by interchanging
the left and right subtrees of v. Define two increasing binary trees T and T ′ on the vertex
set [n] to be equivalent if T ′ can be obtained from T by a sequence of flips. Clearly this
definition of equivalence is an equivalence relation, and the number of increasing binary
trees equivalent to T is 2n−ǫ(T ) , where ǫ(T ) is the number of endpoints of T . The equivalence
classes are in an obvious bijection with increasing (1-2)-trees on the vertex set [n], that is,
increasing (rooted) trees so that every non-endpoint vertex has one or two children. (These
are not plane trees, i.e., the order in which we write the children of a vertex is irrelevant.)

denote the number of equivalence classes, i.e., the number of increasing (1,2)-trees on the
